description: Track packages across 3,000+ carriers with 17TRACK: register tracking numbers, read each package's status and tracking events, list, stop, restart or delete tracked numbers, and start a workflow on each new tracking event.

seventeen_track_package_tracking_updated.description: Runs on each new tracking event of a package you track in 17TRACK, such as a scan in transit, out for delivery or delivered, so one package can start it several times. Choose statuses, such as Delivered or Exception, to run only for packages now in one of them. Packages already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. 17TRACK checks each carrier every 6 to 12 hours, and how often this checks 17TRACK follows your workspace plan.
